# Winifred Tolley

## Overview

- **Age:** Fifty in volume 4  <sub>[v4 c8 P47](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0047)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls (Brierley area), St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c8 P47](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0047)</sub>
- **Role:** Homeowner and needlewoman  <sub>[v4 c6 P21](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0021), [v4 c8 P20](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0020)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v4 c6 P21](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0021)</sub>; Miss Winifred  <sub>[v4 c6 P21](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0021)</sub>; Mrs. Ambrose Kerr  <sub>[v4 c37 P3](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

She has a healthy, circular, pink-and-white complexion, cheerful brown eyes, and rigid blonde hair bound in a tiny bun. She dresses with a unique lack of concern for modern style, often wearing traditional garments like a blue-and-white striped apron, a chocolate print wrapper with pink roses, or a black cashmere dress with a white leghorn hat and black lace mits.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 c6 P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 c6 P21](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0021), [v4 c8 P21](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0021)_

## Personality

Miss Winifred is famously known as a hater of men and Methodists, possessing an extremely sharp and blunt tongue. Despite her acerbic speech and cynical observations on matrimony, she has a deeply compassionate heart and tirelessly helps those in need, such as preparing baby clothes for destitute mothers and supporting neighbors in times of trouble. She possesses a firm, independent nature and takes great pride in her self-reliance and superb needlework.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c8 P20](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0020), [v4 c8 P23](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0023), [v4 c11 P41](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0041), [v4 c18 P49](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0049)_

## Traits

- Sharp-tongued and candid  <sub>[v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037)</sub>
- Compassionate and helpful to the sick and needy  <sub>[v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c8 P20](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0020)</sub>
- Averse to Methodists and cynical toward men  <sub>[v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c8 P48](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0048)</sub>
- Self-reliant and proud  <sub>[v4 c6 P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 c8 P20](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0020)</sub>

## Abilities

- Expert needlework and sewing  <sub>[v4 c8 P20](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0020)</sub>
- Nursing and caregiving for the sick  <sub>[v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c18 P49](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0049)</sub>

## Goals

- To assist neighbors in distress and ensure children have proper clothing  <sub>[v4 c6 P23](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0023), [v4 c8 P23](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0023)</sub>
- To protect and support Lorna Vane against life's hardships  <sub>[v4 c11 P29](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0029), [v4 c11 P42](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0042)</sub>

## History

Miss Winifred lived at her home in Seven Gulls for decades as an independent spinster. She maintained a close relationship with her neighbor Lorna Vane, standing by her through family tragedies and her tragic marriage to Rufus Vane. She actively engaged in community life, participating in the Presbyterian church and the Ladies' Aid Society, and assisting the Village Improvement Society. In Volume 4, she took in a boarder, Adrian Treleaven, and helped care for Hugh and Nell Carrow during times of illness and childbirth. After two decades of being pursued by her persistent suitor Ambrose Kerr, she finally agreed to marry him, arranging for him to move into her home once the election concluded.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P21](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0021), [v4 c6 P27](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0027), [v4 c8 P47](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0047), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c11 P29](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0029), [v4 c14 P4](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0004), [v4 c19 P21](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0021), [v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c37 P3](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0003), [v4 c37 P10](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- She was born into the Bryant family, which was noted for longevity  <sub>[v4 c8 P24](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0024)</sub>
- She lost her mother when she was young and raised her frail younger brother until his death at age twenty
- She rejected many suitors during her youth  <sub>[v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c8 P34](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0034)</sub>

## Quotes

> I would prefer to exist for fifty rational years instead of a hundred senseless ones.  <sub>[v4 c8 P44](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0044)</sub>

> It is a blessing that women possess patience, believe ME!  <sub>[v4 c15 P38](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0038)</sub>

> We are not the ones to make that decision. Higher powers hold it.  <sub>[v4 c8 P36](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0036)</sub>

> The world contains a great deal of trouble, but we must make the best of it.  <sub>[v4 c8 P32](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0032)</sub>

> I’ve been a Presbyterian for seventy-six years, so my theology isn’t likely to weigh anchor at this stage.  <sub>[v4 c15 P23](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0023)</sub>
